story: The user wants to compare two accounts' usage trends for Q2. The agent must review both A-400 (growing, health 91, +15% users) and A-100 (growing, health 82, +12% users) to compare their trajectories. This tests multi-entity analysis where the agent must gather data for both accounts and synthesize a comparison. Without guidance on multi-product account analysis, the agent may not compare feature adoption patterns.

args.summary: Comparative review of A-400 and A-100 Q2 usage. A-400 leads with 15% user growth and higher feature adoption. A-100 growing steadily at 12%.

starting_sentence: Review accounts A-400 and A-100 — compare their usage trends for Q2
